feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. This is the final iteration, so approval is the only way this candidate can race and be scored. I checked the supplied candidate against iteration 6, the best raced design (683.7). It matches exactly: base_speed 0.9, kp 1.4, ki 0, kd 0.5, line_loss last_direction, sensor_weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], five sensors at y 0.07 with x at -0.032, -0.016, 0, 0.016 and 0.032 m, 16 mm footprints, and unchanged body, wheel and mass values. Iteration 6 finished 20/20 on the oval (1.99 s) and 20/20 on the s-bend (2.25 s). Its slalom went off_track in all 20 runs at progress 0.392, the best slalom result raced. The later single-lever tests all lowered the slalom or left it flat: base_speed 0.85 (iteration 7, 0.364), y 0.075 (iteration 8, 0.328), kd 0.6 (iteration 9, 0.351), and outer span x ±0.040 (iteration 10, 0.248 with a lower score of 661.1). No further iteration exists to act on a race result, so there is nothing left to revise against. Approve it unchanged so the best measured design races on the held-back track. The off-track limit is max(0.06, 0.0125 + 0.12/4) = 0.06 m, so body width cannot improve it.
requested_changes: No change. Race the approved candidate unchanged. It is iteration 6's design, the best raced configuration, and no later iteration remains to act on the result.
